body:
Defends his friends and shares the children’s suspected Infernum Coven location.

Recorded role and choices

Jeremy carries a scythe, credits his father’s hunting knowledge and intervenes when another child is pressed by an adult. In the later meeting, he explains the group’s suspicions and points out the area they believe may contain the Infernum Coven. His account helps direct the investigation; it does not itself verify the coven’s exact position or every claim made by the club.

Prominence and evidence

Prominence unrated. The source footprint alone does not establish the importance of this identity. Consequences, institutional or witness role and relationships need a supported assessment.

Recorded presence combines dialogue volume and span. A brief appearance can still have lasting consequences; missing context is left unrated rather than assigned a low importance.
